4 اعضد المَطَرُ , and ↓ عضّد , The moisture of the rain reached [or penetrated] to the [measure of the] عَضُد [or upper arm]. (L.) ―
-b2- رَمَى فَأَعْضَدَ; as also ↓ عضّد , inf. n. تَعْضِيدٌ; [and app. ↓ عَضَدَ likewise, said of an arrow; (see its part. n. عَاضِدٌ;)] (tropical:) He shot, or cast, and it [i. e. the arrow or other missile] went to the right and left (O, K) [or fell on the right, or left, of the butt: see عَاضِدٌ].
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
